newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangnan unit seen in HK$130 mln float.
newsitem.headline: Guangnan unit seen in HK$130 mln float.

text.p: Eel farming concern Chaozhou Industrials Holdings Ltd is expected to issue 125 million new shares, raising about HK$130 million, in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong, market sources said on Tuesday.
Chaozhou Industrials is controlled by listed foodstuffs distributor Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd, which is a unit of Guangdong province's Guangdong Enterprises Group, sources said.
The company is principally engaged in eel farming and roasting, and processing and trading of other aquatic produce.
The new issue is expected to be priced at HK$1.00 to HK$1.10 per share, representing a price/earnings multiple of seven to nine times, they said.
Of the proceeds, about HK$70 million is expected to be used for repayment of loans, with the remaining balance going to working capital, sources said.
Chaozhou Industrials is expected to hold a presentation in early April before it kicks off its IPO later that month, and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on April 15.
Goldwyn Capital and CEF Capital are expected to be the sponsors of the issue.
In January, Guangnan said its 67-percent owned indirect subsidiary Hong Kong Chaozhou Industries Ltd had decided to seek a Hong Kong listing in early 1997.
Market sources explained Chaozhou Industrials is the holding company of Hong Kong Chaozhou Industries.
